description: A link the person taps to book an appointment, with the service (and optionally a team member and date) filled in. You cannot book for them: they pick a time and confirm on the place's own page. Use it for an appointment at a set time (check available_times first if they ask when); for walking in now, use join_link. If the place doesn't take online bookings, it says so: offer join_link instead.

memberId.description: Optional team member id from get_place
